programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程。Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #2
programme.desc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,瞭解這座高地農場「從產地到餐桌」的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事。接著,他前往朵拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦——他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #3
programme.desc: Ben 來到赫斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉。他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #4
programme.desc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家。他們共同的願景��製作天然、以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術。他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #5
programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,瞭解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處。他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調。他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長、與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名。他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史。他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程。Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #1
programme.desc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險、叢林健行、極致享受的巧克力按摩、蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!

programme.title: 夏奇拉: 新時代女性
programme.desc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #1
programme.desc: 祖拜登於2021年1月20日就任美國第46任總統,承諾在分裂的時代後團結和鎮靜,目標是「恢復美國魂」。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #2
programme.desc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響。

programme.title: 空中戰士 10 #6
programme.desc: 細看大型軍用C-5「銀河」運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻。

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #1
programme.desc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到托斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它。

programme.title: 李古查摩美國行 #6
programme.desc: 約翰與洛杉磯地頭蟲喬治羅培茲一起開車前往洛杉磯東部開展他的旅程。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程。Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #2
programme.desc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,瞭解這座高地農場「從產地到餐桌」的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事。接著,他前往朵拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦——他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #3
programme.desc: Ben 來到赫斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉。他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品。

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in US waters by boats, disease and cold weather 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths – 416 animals perished With only a few thousand remaining in the wild, mostly in heavily developed Florida wetlands, the clock is ticking in efforts to save this amazing mammal from extinction

programme.title: Shark Gordon

programme.title: Animal Society
programme.desc: All fish have moveable jaws and are covered in scales, using gills to breath underwater Many forming schools or shoals based on social structure, it’s a unique group arrangement with many benefits

programme.title: Safari Flix

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第1季) #3
programme.desc: 緹娜夏為了保養魔具離城,奧斯卡等人則開始調查接連發生的可疑死亡事件。當拉札爾中毒時,緹娜夏的老友,人稱「封閉之森魔女」的露克芮札出手相救。她在得知奧斯卡希望與緹娜夏結婚時,露出愉悅的笑容。奧斯卡回城後,緹娜夏發現他的生氣竟出現不穩的現象。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第1季) #4
programme.desc: 小國庫斯克爾的使者卡加爾來訪,要求會見緹娜夏。但他卻在緹娜夏拒絕他的邀約後,以魔法操控美蕾蒂娜發動襲擊,讓緹娜夏因此受到不小打擊。從第二天開始 ,緹娜夏要奧斯卡前來蒼藍之塔,開始徹底地鍛鍊他,這一切都是為了讓奧斯卡在未來有更多選擇的機會。

programme.desc: 小國庫斯克爾的使者卡加爾來訪,要求會見緹娜夏。但他卻在緹娜夏拒絕他的邀約後,以魔法操控美蕾蒂娜發動襲擊,讓緹娜夏因此受到不小打擊。從第二天開始 ,緹娜夏要奧斯卡前來蒼藍之塔,開始徹底地鍛鍊他,這一切都是為了讓奧斯卡在未來有更多選擇的機會。

programme.desc: 快跑啊!超可愛的貓咪來了!時間來到21世紀某時期,全世界都被貓咪佔據,有一種病毒會把接觸到貓的人都變成貓,讓全世界爆發貓化大流行,人只要被貓蹭過就會變成貓。人類究竟能否壓抑住想摸貓的衝動,在滿是貓咪的世界中存活下來呢?

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #7
programme.desc: 終於來到副將戰,櫻與十龜的對決即將開始。想起「打架就是『對話』」這番話,除了面對強者的情緒高漲外,與十龜對峙的櫻,內心似乎還萌生不曾體驗過的感受。十龜展現出與平時緩慢舉動截然不同的敏捷身手,但他在得知一切的開端,高架橋下隧道裡的真相後…。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #8
programme.desc: 想起與兔耳山相遇後快樂的時光,在他成為頭領後變了樣的集團,以及自己做過的一切,十龜難掩內心迷惘。感覺到十龜的變化,櫻首次在打架中產生想要了解對方的念頭。兩人以拳對話,帶著笑容戰鬥的模樣震撼全場,而劃破場內沉默的是十龜的一句「到此結束吧」。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #8
programme.desc: 緋紅為了追擊在與拉格納的戰鬥中身心皆被逼入絕境的奧偍瑪蒂亞,下令炸毀王都多處。出乎意料之外的事態讓奧偍瑪蒂亞精神上備受打擊,瀕臨極限狀態的她雖想再次發動回溯世界的魔法,但是……。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #9
programme.desc: 轉移失敗而在雷傑王國被捕的緋紅受到銀器公主絲塔莉亞審問。為脫離險境,緋紅使出渾身解數以高超演技進行交涉。但絲塔莉亞卓越的敏銳感受力,看穿了她的危險本質。在千鈞一髮之際醒來的拉格納化解了眼前危機,但絲塔莉亞的樣子卻在見到拉格納後變得不對勁。

programme.title: 地球大神祕(國語)
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:幸虧我還有神 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蔡錦圖博士-小先知書的大意義
屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#20粵
programme.desc: 高慶捉拿小偷，說做賊辱及祖先，令小偷嘆服。高慶收到神秘包裹後，訂機票到英國。高慶又收到包裹，內裡是男性唐裝衣服。原來當日高慶之父高超「包二奶」，「二奶」母女被高慶之母趕走，「二奶女」高麗稱她已在香港。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#31粵普PG
programme.desc: 區勵行欲借百壽圖對付徐家之事敗露受罰，區彥行希望區家別再與徐家作對，反被指吃裡扒外。徐令宜南下游說王久保接受招安，期間十一娘日夜思念徐令宜，夫妻倆感情日深；區勵行叫秦姨娘設法離間徐令宜夫妻之間的關係。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 廣東人喜愛一盅兩件，阿譚邀請拍檔品嚐「三色龍蝦餃」等新派點心，鼎爺還分享來自「老頭子」的享用「蜂巢炸芋角」方法。鼎爺這次除了示範「鴨腳紮」的傳統版本，也會巧製「竹笙版」增添口感層次。市面可容易買到經油炸處理的鴨腳，何解鼎爺堅持用新鮮貨，寧願多花功夫？天冷時候適合吃羊補身，中西方各有以香料炮製羊肉的食譜。鼎爺以孜然粉、五香粉奉上中式「乾炸羊排」；阿譚則採用迷迭香炮製「西式焗羊架」，盡皆香濃惹味！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 踏入四十歲後，肌肉量逐漸流失，或導致體能減退，平衡力亦可能下降。骨科醫生指出，肌肉不足會增加跌倒風險，甚或引致骨折。他建議不論男女老幼，都可透過負重運動增肌，有助保持健康。方伊琪、譚炳文的女兒譚淑瑩，將聯同葉振棠等歌手藝人舉行演唱會，大唱經典電視金曲。兩人亮相節目，分享促成這次合作的緣分。此外，方姨淺談八字養生心得，淑瑩亦分享父親教誨。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐炮製「麻辣豆豉爆炒豬腩肉」，香辣惹味。

programme.title: 健康必殺食粵
programme.desc: 江嘉敏、梁凱晴、邵初參考六號「小學雞」畫作，下田採摘超級食物，有人卻不知何謂十字花科？廚藝達人陳曉樺用椰菜花代白飯，配上富抗氧化功效的紫椰菜花、蔓越莓，營養更均衡；另以辣木葉粉製作健康版可麗餅。薑黃注入手搖飲品，味道如何？天貝加進素食料理，可補充蔬菜缺乏的蛋白質。用薑黃粉、秋葵、藜麥等煮飯，營養升級；湛錦鈿下廚時被指與某藝人撞樣，更即興唱歌？乳酪促進腸道健康、味噌提升免疫力，二者結合燉雞，好殺食！

programme.title: 陪著你走#13粵
programme.desc: 導生要回韓國寄養家庭終老，言重勸天從堅強面對。言重站在天從家的點字牆前，想知道箇中意義，並拍下照片。言重驚訝發現自己可直視導生。導生準備上機，天從強忍眼淚與牠道別。何娜為海報把秀玄的名字印錯而動氣……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 聽到同學們說起善解人意的爸爸，再回家目睹自己爸爸宏志醉醺醺的樣子，令小丸子產生了比較心理，對爸爸滿肚牢騷。小丸子更嘗試透過改變稱謂，希望讓宏志變成理想中的好爸爸，但宏志卻依然故我……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 四位零食女兵來到「甜品城堡」闖關，蚌蚌公主大讚她們於「廠長話」環節表現出色，要提升難度以考驗大家。接着踏入果園執行收集任務，兩隊多次因不慎觸響鈴鐺警報而受阻，公主於是建議大家可撐扶支柱來協助平衡，能否改善情況？在「溶化之橋」關卡，即使僅僅運送三個雪糕球，也甚具挑戰性。有小兵因大意失手掉落雪糕球，但她勇於再次挑戰，不放棄的精神值得嘉獎。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 勝仁向阿渡和阿驅解釋現時情況，並送走二人去和炎上達決戰。炎上彈吸收人類世界的炎上之力後變成炎上太陽，御富良院為阻止炎上達而犧牲。兩人看過御富良院留下的影片後，重新振作創造出神龍王丸。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 大腸癌在本地致命癌症中排第二位，由於早期幾乎毫無症狀，會容易被忽略，甚麼是這個病的高風險因素？益生菌種類繁多，如何幫小朋友選擇？服用時還有甚麼要注意？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 不小心駕駛違例的車主疑遇索償敲詐報道，引起不少回響，節目組再接獲類似報料，詳情如何？巴士安全帶法例快將生效，市民乘公共交通工具要強制配戴安全帶，這集帶來懶人包。美孚某天橋底的公共空間是外傭週日聚會熱點，近期卻現霸位圖利事件。三名婆婆疑趁半夜鋪滿紙皮霸位，再向外傭索取「買位費」。攝製隊追蹤「紙皮婆婆」疑各據一方「搵食」，大狀評論事件可有違法。《非常檢控觀》眾演員齊聚飯局，觀看劇集首播，並暢談感受。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2727粵
programme.desc: 天娥收到Ivan的電郵，不虞有詐下被標題吸引，並點擊附帶的有毒連結，結果手機中毒；璟風、尚善亦因不同理由「中招」。Ivan稱發送有毒電郵，是為了測試眾人的網絡安全意識。力蓮要求Ivan開設特別課程，為三人傳授網絡安全相關知識，獲敢威批准。課程內容及所需時間遠超眾人預期，原來力蓮逼他們上課另有目的。尚善識破力蓮的用意，遂設法盡快「畢業」，並向力蓮還以顏色。最終，尚善與力蓮竟展開一場「網絡攻防戰」……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#2粵PG
programme.desc: 逸桐與四位義兄合稱「陷空道五鼠」，她決意要找出在逃刀手下落；律政書記公孫珀使計讓車堡的仇家郭奉孝道出刀手身分。逸桐偷去車堡的手機，遭熊飛截獲，察覺熊飛似另有所圖。希仁設法引蛇出洞，在熊飛幫忙下終令害死文頂的真兇被起訴！新來的實習檢控官趙子幀原來是希仁上司趙德敬之子，也是希仁的表弟。希仁向公孫珀提到當年離開趙家的原因。希仁出席韓國偶像陳新彌的簽唱會，遇上女子秦湘言當眾扯開新彌的衣衫，更自稱是其妻子！

programme.title: 宿敵契約#21粵普
programme.desc: 隨歌被送到風雨盟；戲陽以為父皇和皇兄死了，要求靜炎幫她查證，靜炎亦發現自己愛上戲陽；太后要求戲陽跟靜石復婚；隨歌醒來後失明了，凌峰與周昊找來安姑，為他治好失明，但他卻失憶，失去了他與一笑一起的記憶…

programme.title: 聚大金鳳呈獻:在家宴客60道菜粵
programme.desc: 中式清湯腩相信大家都曾吃過，西廚Jacques這次卻帶來瑞士家鄉風味，牛坑腩配西芹頭、皺葉椰菜等蔬菜燜煮，清甜又爽口。香草焗雞簡單易學，宴客「零失敗」！五色蔬菜「墊底」吸盡雞油香味，嘉欣向肥媽求問雞皮香脆金黃的竅門。涼菜是不可缺少的派對美食，鼎爺教煮「酒香醉蝦」，提到鮮蝦餵酒蒸熟後要即時冰鎮，醉汁更有黃金比例！李文星師傅將鯪魚肉加臘肉碎，分途釀入羊肚菌、混合豆腐，蒸出多重口感的升級版「老少平安」。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 名媛望族#26粵
programme.desc: 爾嫣往醫院，日輝表示在現場執到卓萬呔夾。三蝦替卓萬錄口供，卓萬謂案發時與爾嫣一起，爾嫣表示記不起。卓萬與啟燊回家，爾嫣掌摑他；卓萬回想啟燁反應覺可疑。木水只認得小由，子君提議下，心蘭讓木水住花園小屋。

programme.desc: 導生要回韓國寄養家庭終老，言重勸天從堅強面對。言重站在天從家的點字牆前，想知道箇中意義，並拍下照片。言重驚訝發現自己可直視導生。導生準備上機，天從強忍眼淚與牠道別。何娜為海報把秀玄的名字印錯而動氣……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#20粵
programme.desc: 高慶捉拿小偷，說做賊辱及祖先，令小偷嘆服。高慶收到神秘包裹後，訂機票到英國。高慶又收到包裹，內裡是男性唐裝衣服。原來當日高慶之父高超「包二奶」，「二奶」母女被高慶之母趕走，「二奶女」高麗稱她已在香港。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#31粵普PG
programme.desc: 區勵行欲借百壽圖對付徐家之事敗露受罰，區彥行希望區家別再與徐家作對，反被指吃裡扒外。徐令宜南下游說王久保接受招安，期間十一娘日夜思念徐令宜，夫妻倆感情日深；區勵行叫秦姨娘設法離間徐令宜夫妻之間的關係。

programme.title: 街坊廚神舌戰新台韓粵
programme.desc: 舌戰韓國最後一回，主持和嘉賓曾志偉、田蕊妮品嚐多道養生料理，接着「喪食」韓、港的五香豬蹄。主持在港繼續「養生」，細味本土、韓式新派素菜。「學廚PK賽」，兩位主持以「雞胸桔梗牛油果青瓜卷」定出終極勝負！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#21粵
programme.desc: 高麗突然來到藥房，高慶不敢相見。高麗更跑上高家，蕙婷遇上高麗，二人神秘地乘搭的士離去。蕙婷失蹤，電話中卻傳來蕙婷呼救的聲音，閉路電視看到蕙婷向高麗求饒。蕙婷入院，眾人竟因此揭破高麗來港的真正目的。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#32粵普
programme.desc: 二夫人欲作畫給二爺，秦姨娘推薦二夫人找彥行幫忙。後來太夫人知道彥行為區家人，大為不滿，要十一娘退出仙綾閣，禁足於西跨院，二娘向太夫人說情，太夫人本已心軟，但秦姨娘火上加油，讓太夫人決定好好管束十一娘。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 順德街市有售各種港人少見的食材，鼎爺帶拍檔見識攤檔販賣的新鮮鱷魚肉、活生生蠍子。不過，阿譚卻似乎對「家常」鯪魚滑更感興趣。鼎爺於是帶來「手切鯪魚滑釀豆角」，鯪魚滑以三種刀功切成多重口感，再混合冬菇粒、蝦米粒釀入豆角環，滋味加倍昇華！來到本地街市，鼎爺講解多款蟶子的分別，還應阿譚要求炮製一道「豆瓣醬爆蟶子」。吃海鮮謹記注重衛生，蟶子不單要切開洗淨內臟與穢物，更要留意火候，才可保持肉質爽嫩。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「呼吸道合胞病毒」(RSV)是常見的呼吸道病毒，為何嬰幼兒特別易感染，更會增加患上哮喘的風險？婦產科醫生提醒家長留意年幼子女的狀況，減低延誤治療的可能性，較理想是懷孕中後期就接種疫苗保護嬰兒。曾參加《剪裁魔法師2》的時裝設計師王業凡帶同作品到臨受訪，並示範怎樣用絲巾搭配，襯托出不同感覺；他還會分享於農曆年的配襯小技巧。鹽焗雞要在家做，有點麻煩？大可隨「睇餸食飯」李文星師傅的做法，家中亦能簡易烹煮。

programme.title: 健康必殺食粵
programme.desc: 家禽類的蛋、海產類的卵，都極具營養價值。衍峰、林秀怡、陳詩欣、林鈺洧開展尋卵之行，由「大食到細」！鵝蛋的營養和卡路里，是雞蛋的三倍，簡單煎荷包蛋已甚滋味。到雞場尋找孖黃蛋，秀怡、鈺洧竟被嚇到雞飛狗走？中式燕窩鴿蛋糖水，養顏之選；法式鵪鶉蛋伴魚子醬牛肉他他，口感如何？蛋是百搭食材，大廚陳國強帶來不一樣的九肚魚老燒蛋、川味蒸水蛋；陳曉樺則選用有益心血管健康的烏魚子，及富美顏功效的白子，烹調卡邦尼意粉。

programme.title: 陪著你走#14粵PG
programme.desc: 天從摸出照片，得何娜解釋知道是她與導生常出現的地方。言重找莎莉翻譯點字，又把電子蒸籠放到天從公司的茶水間。3L同事在《雙戰》首映跟言重擁抱慰問，天從感言重地位重要。言重邊吃爆谷，邊將戲中畫面告訴天從。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子看見百惠穿大紅色晚裝很漂亮，於是自己也打扮到全身紅色，更遇上同樣一身火紅的青年音樂人。藤木發現藍色能代表自己，更是很好的顏色，於是打扮到一身藍色，卻意外吸引到一名女生的目光。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 民安隊是保安局轄下的輔助部隊，工作範圍廣泛，其中一項是緊急救援行動。「Kids’ Notes」請來兩位隊員，展示民安隊的基本裝備，並介紹近年引入的新科技，如何協助搜救任務。兩位隊員最難忘的拯救行動都是與山嶺有關，究竟遠足人士在「衣、食、行、急」方面可怎樣做好？嘉賓提醒觀眾切忌獨自遠足，也要預先下載官方行山應用程式及相關離線地圖，以便記錄行程。此外，他們亦為大家推薦易行的親子郊遊路線。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 炎上太陽開始升空，阿渡和阿驅設法阻止，並從御富良院的影片得到啟發，想到用水龍頭把炎上能量釋放。善意的留言令瑪蘿甦醒並化身天照大神，眾人合力之下，最終成功消滅炎上太陽並擊敗炎上達。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 油塘海邊一個新盤，驗樓師發現，外牆有空心磚，浴室也有石材崩花，如何執修？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2728粵
programme.desc: 大四喜應邀為某間公司的周年晚宴表演，卻因家聰準備不足而出錯。眾人責怪家聰辦事不力，家聰趁機辭去經理人的職務。大四喜急需找人頂替家聰，偶然發現一位合適人選。新經理人「落力」為大四喜打點一切，並安排眾人參與不同活動，敢威等人卻因此備受折磨。樹根終於忍無可忍，將新經理人辭退。後來，樹根物色到另一位合適的經理人人選，遂帶此人往見敢威等人，認為其他人亦會贊成他的提議，詎料……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#3粵PG
programme.desc: 湘言被控非禮，卻稱新彌是其失蹤丈夫文貴利，重投警隊的熊飛接手此案。希仁、熊飛推斷新彌有可能整容及改名換姓。希仁為見新彌，出席家族飯局，其母趙舟警告不可得罪新彌這個代言人，希仁卻設法試探他。湘言突然認罪，希仁等要查出箇中原因……湘言其後態度大變，拒絕與眾人合作。希仁查到湘言曾經流產，懷疑此事另有內情。希仁等為搜證出席拍賣會，希仁重遇嫂子王頌星，兩人曾有一段舊情。逸桐替熊飛辦事，取得新彌的身份證……

programme.title: 宿敵契約#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 戲陽不信殺父兄的是慕容父子，隨歌再醒來視一笑為敵，安姑勸一笑離開，一笑想起隨歌說過的話，自己答應不會離開。太后眼見靜炎不聽話便拉攏靜石，承陽要沈務查平城死因，為喚起隨歌記憶，一笑握著隨歌的劍鋒刺自己…

programme.title: 聚大金鳳呈獻:在家宴客60道菜粵
programme.desc: 中國人認為豬手寓意「橫財就手」，肥媽帶來葡式煮意，既有特色亦適合於佳節宴客。用海味待客更顯矜貴，許美德師傅以新派潮州菜手法炮製金蠔。他特別以龍鬚絲、蝦膠包裹金蠔再下鍋油炸，可帶出蠔的香味之餘，同時保留蠔汁精華。鼎爺將鹹酸梅、梅酒梅子剁碎混合成醬，為蒸蟶子提鮮，做法簡單易學，墊底的粉絲更是吸盡鮮味。廣東人宴客多會準備「靚湯」，幟哥呈獻川芎天麻燉魚頭。想要燉出滋味湯品，原來用水亦有講究，幟哥有何見解？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

名媛望族#27粵
programme.desc: 爾嫣出庭說出事實，終令卓萬脫罪。卓萬向兒子表示，曾爵士放棄提名他入定例局。爾嫣寫了休書要求卓萬簽名，卓萬拒絕。爾熹到來指日輝自殺，請爾嫣勸阻，卓萬阻止。子君把爾嫣偷運到教堂，讓爾嫣見日輝，被浩頤發現。

programme.title: 娛樂大家粵PG
programme.desc: 本輯最後一集，召齊過往集數的精英，發放更多笑彈。「Cheat精」李佳芯、黎諾懿、王君馨、麥美恩、Bob、小儀享用美食兼上演言語攻防戰，但甫開始森美已滑鐵盧！進擊的阿Bob竟被夾最多飾物，而傾談間竟有新劇構思？高海寧、江嘉敏、鄧佩儀、劉佩玥、何超蓮、JW、陳曉華、翟威廉化身刺客或君臣，再來一次「高玩」之戰。高手雲集，有人集齊全輯節目的遊戲數據，也有人大篇分析，令刺客們頻頻講錯話，壞人陣營輕易被殲滅！

香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#22粵
programme.desc: 高慶愛鍚高麗，不過由於高麗有潔癖，眾人希望高麗盡快離港回英。眾人又以為高麗為了他們而一貧如洗，計劃「還錢」給她。高麗得悉眾人的付出，將錢還給他們，眾人更揭發高麗所謂的「減磅」，是指她的體重突然下降。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#33粵普
programme.desc: 秦姨娘有意讓琥珀看到佟姨娘的半條手帕，並稱佟姨娘的死與元娘有關；徐太夫人準備給令宜納妾，琥珀有意向杜媽媽說起令宜貼身衣物丟失，而杜媽媽向太夫人提起此事，認為是冬青拿的，於是太夫人想到給令宜納冬青為妾。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 品嚐靚牛肉不單要認清來源地，不同牛隻部位亦各有滋味，位於汕頭的「一條龍」火鍋店到底有何美味過人之處？日本和牛被奉為上等食材，鼎爺卻認為本地黃牛絕不失禮，遂以同樣配料分別搭配和牛、黃牛，炮製出兩道「三色炒牛肉」，吃盡兩地牛肉風味。愛吃牛肉的鼎爺原來曾戒牛24年，背後只因一個承諾！潮州芥蘭份外鮮嫩，品種亦多。荷塘芥蘭、紅腳芥蘭的處理方法不盡相同，鼎爺藉着「方魚炒芥蘭」菜式「打孖上」，詳述當中烹調要訣。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 慢性盆腔炎是常見婦科疾病，從中醫學角度，有何成因與證型？醫師針對不同證型提供改善建議，並細談日常生活中的預防方法。舌癌康復者過往縱接受漫長的治療，甚至要重新學習說話、進食，仍無阻其積極面對人生的選擇。嘉賓坦言曾陷入谷底，卻因好友送贈的小手工獲得力量，還因此立志成為義工，以陪伴更多病友走過低潮。她攜來自製的打氣小手工受訪，分享深刻助人經歷。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨師傅示範「意式滷水拼盤」。

programme.title: 健康必殺食粵
programme.desc: 春天着重祛濕、健脾，常用薏米煲水，生、熟、洋薏米的功效可有差別？山楂開胃健脾、陳皮理氣化痰，分別搭配薏米煮成特飲，有助趕走「春困」。提到薏米水不宜孕婦飲用，江嘉敏竟自言「長期懷孕」？結合淮山麵、豬肚的藥膳菜則健脾益胃。大廚陳國強另選滋陰補肺的蟲草精華，奉上進補湯水。六號聯同嘉敏、邵初、黃頌明到街市物色當造蔬菜，找到溫中行氣的韭菜、有助抗炎的唐芹；湛錦鈿接力炮製津白卷、韓式炒粉絲，帶來春日養生料理。

programme.title: 陪著你走#15粵PG
programme.desc: 何娜在公司接到秀玄電話後趕到機場……天從關心言重找阮婉的事。何娜和玄秀抵沖繩，秀玄帶她到教堂註冊結婚。言重從街市跟加勁回家，希望他煲湯和煮辣子雞給天從吃，加勁明白老友在談戀愛。白叔告訴秀玄他成名了……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子去圖書館尋找自由研究的題材，卻在那裡遇見山田，對方打算研究妖怪，並建議兩人一起寫作業。暑假最後一個星期天，天氣酷熱，小丸子尚未完成暑期功課，卻出外跟朋友玩耍，更意外弄髒衣服。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 教練Miki姐姐這次將教大家利用普拉提球，提升脊椎靈活性，以及鍛練腹部及腿部的肌肉，是時候開始「WORKOUT 2GETHER」。教練首先示範「美人魚式」，名字優雅，動作卻頗具挑戰性，應怎樣做？還有一個動作是將普拉提球放在腰前，靠球與腹部核心力量撐起上半身，雙手同時伸後觸碰臀部，難度亦不低。本集還會播放 AI生成動畫《白鴿和螞蟻》的下半部。故事中，白鴿在樹上休息時被獵人持弓箭瞄準，螞蟻將如何相救？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 在偶像公主大賽途中，美月竟說二人組要解散，令陽葵大受打擊。阿紡知道她倆正在吵架，為了讓她們和好如初，繼而周旋二人之間。可是，由於溝通失誤，反令陽葵與美月關係惡化。大賽當前，三人應如何是好？

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 失禁，一個普遍又令人難於啟齒的問題，很多人都有誤解，甚至醫生都未必懂得醫治。長期受失禁影響，對患者的心理造成多大困擾？又有何治療方法呢？新聞掏寶重溫2003年的專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2729粵
programme.desc: 城安因瑞素影響而瀕臨失業，只好嘗試尋找兼職以維持生計，卻屢屢碰壁。此時，城安偶然遇上李莫仇。莫仇原來與城安處境相同，她出資要求城安協助她佯裝上班，以瞞騙親人。危機得以解除，莫仇介紹城安加入一個「失業」群組。城安因此發現商機，決定開設公司，幫助其他失業人士「扮工」；創業初期十分成功，但後來出現了「員工」流失的問題。城安設法解決，成功扭轉局面，凌凌卻察覺到不妥……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#4粵PG
programme.desc: 文貴利與前女友所生的女兒文晶晶疑偷偷來港，湘言找新彌探問其下落，但不果，擔心下向熊飛求助，熊飛成功讓她對新彌死心。湘言收到訊息，往酒店等待與新彌會面，那裡卻發生墮樓案。湘言被當成疑犯，頌星出任其辯護律師，希仁懷疑頌星另有目的。熊飛向認識死者張詩雅的逸桐打探消息，追查下發現詩雅死前曾見過晶晶……頌星提出以精神錯亂作為湘言的抗辯理由，湘言卻仍起用頌星。熊飛找到新彌褓姆車的定位紀錄，循這線索追尋晶晶……

programme.title: 宿敵契約#23粵普PG
programme.desc: 守拙想把消息藏在膳食裡，被戲陽和靜炎抓個正著。守拙不承認他是靜石的人，靜炎讓靜石親手殺了守拙以證明清白；隨歌和一笑打算離開風雨盟，寧非提醒他們，被救治的人終生不能離開風雨盟，這是風雨盟救人的規矩。

programme.title: 聚大金鳳呈獻:在家宴客60道菜粵
programme.desc: 中式燜蛋餅的口感鬆軟綿滑，似吃梳乎厘？邵師傅示範由外往內的推蛋技巧，並以蝦仁、烏魚子碎添鮮、增香。「陳皮滷水獅頭鵝」都可在家燜煮，肥媽帶來簡易版食譜，用鵝脂起鑊、陳皮點綴提升香味，火候掌控亦是關鍵。常說「無雞不成宴」，幟哥自製韭菜蔥油、剁椒醬，呈現雙重滋味的「鴛鴦雞」，再以傳統竹盤盛起，驚喜滿滿！香噴噴煲仔飯考驗廚藝功夫，鼎爺這次奉上「豬油渣芋頭臘味」風味，還傳授米水比例與煮飯焦的「不敗」秘訣。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 名媛望族#28粵
programme.desc: 卓萬發現爾嫣之事，斥子君當他的話是耳邊風，子君斥他專制。卓萬認識售貨員丹丹，她成功挑逗卓萬。懿芳與啟燁借酒澆愁，啟燁看見采月，命她入房陪他。懿芳不滿木水態度欲教訓他，木水竟緊抱懿芳，又送她麵粉公仔。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#22粵
programme.desc: 高慶愛鍚高麗，不過由於高麗有潔癖，眾人希望高麗盡快離港回英。眾人又以為高麗為了他們而一貧如洗，計劃「還錢」給她。高麗得悉眾人的付出，將錢還給他們，眾人更揭發高麗所謂的「減磅」，是指她的體重突然下降。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 五位女神憑個人標籤挑選隊友，誰自稱電眼殺手？誰成為新一代天然呆男星？主持先請大家飲奶，隨後用彈指神功令膠杯翻騰後着陸，氣氛緊張！隊友互相合作，按次序把顏色水泡套到身上，或簡單的「泡泡球相撲」遊戲，都做成一片混亂，期間體現到蔚雨芯、劉佩玥骨子裏的體育精神。常識及智力題，張振朗努力搶答，竟令隊友何廣沛目露凶光；亦顯露出丁子朗及連詩雅常識不足！爭獎品遊戲於燒烤場舉行，盡情煽風撥火吧！誰是真正大贏家？

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 歡唱小浣熊

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. programme.title: Lilly's Disappearance (2)
programme.desc: Lilly has now been missing for days without a trace. A journalist convinces Anna and Robert that the media could help. Meanwhile, the police unexpectedly focus the investigation on Lilly’s own parents. And the evidence against them is mounting.

programme.title: Veins Of The World
programme.desc: After his father dies in a tragic car accident, 11-year-old Amra sets out to continue his father’s vision of the traditional nomad way of life and to continue his fight against global mining companies who threaten to destroy it.

programme.title: Three Times Nothing
programme.desc: When three homeless friends win the lottery, they assume their lives are going to change drastically for the better. But claiming the money turns out to be more of a problem than a solution.

programme.title: Dogworld
programme.desc: In the near future, two friends dream of leaving the Italian city of Taranto, a wasteland ruled over by warring gangs and surrounded by barbed wire. Recruited by a local gang, and with a girl coming between them, their friendship is put to the test.

programme.title: Erased (2018)
programme.desc: Ana gives birth at a local hospital, but is shocked to find out that her file is no longer on the government network. Without legal status, she must struggle against government bureaucracy to keep her child and her identity.

programme.title: Wajma, An Afghan Love Story
programme.desc: In conservative Kabul, young Wajma discovers she is pregnant out of wedlock. Her boyfriend denies paternity and her father locks her up for being a disgrace. Driven by desperation, Wajma takes extreme measures forcing everyone to re-think their actions.

While overseeing renovations to her beach house in 1970s Chile, Carmen’s quiet life is upended when a priest asks her to hide a wounded fugitive. As she steps beyond her quiet life, Carmen is pulled into the undercurrents of a politically tumultuous Chile.

programme.title: Galloping Mind
programme.desc: A pair of twins are separated at birth and meet again twelve years later. Attracted by a nebulous bond, they begin an exciting journey of their roots and become destined for a brutal confrontation with their past.

programme.title: Deal At The Border
programme.desc: Aza and Samat, two drug runners navigating the secret routes in the mountains of Central Asia, stumble upon Nazik, a young girl fleeing from slavery. When Nazik is recaptured by a criminal, facing a grim return to captivity, Aza resolves to save her.

programme.title: The Key Witness
programme.desc: BKA bodyguard Jan Schäfer must protect Fiona Weibel, a key witness for the International Tribunal of the Law of the Sea. With Weiber having insider knowledge of a Swiss shipping company's illicit activities, a game of cat and mouse over her life begins.

programme.title: Otar's Death

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - White Cliffs of Dover, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to save the White Cliffs of Dover when Glitch digs for classroom chalk

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Bumpy And The Wise Old Wolfhound
programme.desc: Bingo is sick in hospital, so Bluey and Dad sent her a homemade video to lift her spirits. It tells the tale of Barnicus' quest to heal her spotty dog named Bumpy.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Postman
programme.desc: When Mum and Dad have a disagreement, Bluey makes Dad write a love letter to Mum to make up. Bluey must find a way to play Ground's Lava with Bingo and deliver the letter to Mum, without squabbling.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Tiger Cubs
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Bandhavgarh tiger reserve in India on a baby animal mission to track down a female tiger and her new born cubs. Along the way, our team outwit a sloth that strays dangerously close to the den where the cubs are resting.

programme.title: Dog Squad (S2) - Mission: Sunflower Mystery
programme.desc: Tinks is excited to visit the allotments again with her owner Charli to see how tall their sunflowers have grown. Tinks is a disability assistance dog for Charli and helps Charli every day.

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild (S2) - Indian Peafowl and Gorilla
programme.desc: This episode features the Indian peafowl and the gorilla - their wild connection is they are dimorphic, meaning the male and female have a different appearance.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Hoop
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Building Block Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels become architects so they can bring to life their very own clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Reunion Badge
programme.desc: Duggee hosts a reunion for the first ever Squirrels he looked after.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Counting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels try the ultimate achievement of counting to 100 to earn their counting badge

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Mount Etna, Italy
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch makes popcorn in Mount Etna, Italy, he blocks the volcano and endangers farms on its slopes.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Taj Mahal, India
programme.desc: The grimbots attach a bit of the Taj Mahal to GrimHQ. It remains to be seen whether the Go Jetters can fix the glitch.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - A New Arrival
programme.desc: When Thomas finds out that the Earl's Technology Fair will bring new inventions to Sodor, he fears the Sodor engines will be replaced by new technology.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Kite
programme.desc: Stanley helps Little Woo and Seamus fly their new kite. It gets stuck up a tree and breaks. Using leaves and sticks, they build a better one, only for that to get stuck.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Heavy
programme.desc: Stanley and Morris put too many boxes on the barge and now one end is sinking and the other is lifting up. Stanley get's the townsfolk to help level it out.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Tiny Little Me
programme.desc: When Monty and Jimmy Jones discover that Jeanie is having trouble writing lyrics for her song, they suggest they all spend some time in the backyard looking for inspiration, and imagine what the garden would look like if they were shrunk down to the size of a bee.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to Search for Seashells
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are at the beach and begin to look for lots of different types of shells. They also discover a rock pool, some limpets and a hermit crab - which runs away!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Listening Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels hear a strange sound that they've not heard before, so they ask Duggee to help identify it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Choir Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels become enchanted when they hear a piece of music from Duggee's choir. They quickly learn what makes a choir.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Blue Mountains, Jamaica
programme.desc: Trouble brews in Jamaica when Glitch's campfire threatens a coffee plantation.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Peas
programme.desc: Two peas perform a happy song.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Lemon
programme.desc: Lemon performs a stand-up routine!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Evil Pea's Veggie Vision
programme.desc: Evil Pea is tricked by lots of Supertatoes who appear all over the supermarket.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Come Back Cobs
programme.desc: The Cobs have finally had enough of Evil Pea's ungratefulness and team up with Supertato.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - I Spy
programme.desc: The voice trumpet leads a game of 'I Spy' where the Teletubbies have to spot different colours - purple, green, yellow and red. What or who can they spot with those colours?

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: In this period martial arts thriller, three police graduates are assigned to a town rife with crimes and corruption. They vow to uphold justice but are hampered by their corrupt superior, resulting in them putting their lives and the lives of their beloved in danger.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named "The Fastest Sword" but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards' heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because it's also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily found help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughter's lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father's martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung's passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu's disciple.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu is a government officer heading home after being charged with falsifying reports. En route, he encounters &amp;amp; recruits a skilled swordsman as a bodyguard. They then meet a fleeing bride and her maid who asked to join them for protection. When the group reach a ruined temple however, a gang of assassins appear and attack them...

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by "Drunken Master", this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The Gambling Ghost
programme.desc: Sammo Hung plays three roles: Fatty, Fatty's father and grandfather. Hoping to become rich, hotel staff Fatty dives into gambling with his friend to the dismay of his father. When Fatty hits rock bottom, his grandfather's ghost appears to help him. As Fatty finds out that his grandfather was murdered, he vows to avenge his death.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: An archaeologist Jack, and a scientist William, stumble upon ancient Qin Dynasty artifacts that lead them to the mausoleum and mysteriously connects Jack to his past life as a warrior in ancient China, starting their mythical journey.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: An archaeologist Jack, and a scientist William, stumble upon ancient Qin Dynasty artifacts that lead them to the mausoleum and mysteriously connects Jack to his past life as a warrior in ancient China, starting their mythical journey.

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: World Insight with Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion. It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews. programme.desc: Cecil shows Patrick his mustache collection. The Star family brings a mandrake root into their home.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - Mind the Gap

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Jack the Clipper

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - The Boba-Get Be Your Own Bean

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Before 10AM
programme.desc: Lil and her BFFs Anusha &amp; Debs fight to win the coveted trophy at Hank N Beans arcade.

programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick exchange tiny living versions of themselves. It's a whole hunk of homunculus fun! Plankton tells his Grandma that he owns the Krusty Krab, but must keep the lie going when she comes to visit.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - Karen's Baby

programme.desc: Patrick hires other Patricks to entertain at parties. Pat-Thos shares a Hamdonian tale of love and pork products.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - Late for Breakfast
programme.desc: Patrick presents a show about food after missing out on a hearty breakfast.

programme.title: The Smurfs S1 - Chef Soup Adventures in Smurfsitting
programme.desc: When Brainy criticizes Chef's cooking, Chef walks out in a huff and ends up cooking for the Ogres. When Clumsy and Dimwitty take care of Baby, they try to show all of Smurf Village how smurfsome they really are.

programme.title: The Smurfs S1 - The Round Up Waffle Wednesday
programme.desc: Jokey gives Farmer's racing snails an extra kick from a magic potion that makes them super fast. Chef gets jealous when Lily starts to make waffles that are more delicious than his.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - Zoo-mergency!

programme.title: The Gypsies_Season 2 - Sandhan Valley,India
programme.desc: On an adventurous trek in Maharashtra’s ‘Valley of Shadows’, Krisann finds herself challenged to confront her fear of heights.

programme.title: Backpack - Brac and Split, Croatia
programme.desc: After trying out a few adventurous activities in Brac?, Alex Outhwaite explores Diocletian’s Palace in Split.

programme.title: Timeless Tamil Nadu - Mahabalipuram, India
programme.desc: Alex visits the world-famous temples of Mahabalipuram to explore the architectural style of the pioneers of South Indian architecture.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland - Aberdeen
programme.desc: At the Highland Games in Perth, Robbie is faced with one of the most important rites of passage for a true Highlander: the caber toss.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan - Phobjikha
programme.desc: Radhika Bangia visits Bumthang, the religious heart of Bhutan, where she explores the sacred sites and the legends surrounding them.

programme.title: The Gypsies - Hanumantiya, India
programme.desc: Built on the backwaters of Indira Sagar Dam, the island of Hanuwantiya was designed to be a paradise for adventure lovers.

programme.title: The Gypsies_Season 2 - Pune,India
programme.desc: From paragliding to trying ‘misal’, Krisann and Reanne’s adventures in Pune have them both stepping out of their comfort zones.

programme.title: Backpack - Split and Salona, Croatia
programme.desc: Alex Outhwaite learns about the Roman history of Croatia at Split, the second largest city in Croatia. She also visits the ruins of Salona.

programme.title: Timeless Tamil Nadu - Thanjavur, India
programme.desc: Why is Thanjavur called the "the Cradle of Arts"? Alex soon discovers this, as she navigates through the city’s art forms.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland - Aberdeenshire
programme.desc: Nestled in the craggy embrace of Aberdeenshire's hills, Robbie stumbles upon the Scotland less bragged about.

programme.title: Xplore India - Chhattisgarh 1
programme.desc: Aradhana embarks on an adventure to uncover the hidden wonders of a land steeped in spirituality and untamed wilderness: Chhattisgarh!

programme.title: The Gypsies - Tawa, India
programme.desc: Krisann and Benafsha’s adventures in Madhya Pradesh lead them to Satpura National Park, where they set out to explore on a boat.

programme.title: The Gypsies_Season 2 - Sindhudurg,India
programme.desc: Krisann and Reanne get a peek into the masterful defense strategies of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj at Sindhudurg.

programme.title: Backpack - Zadar, Croatia
programme.desc: Alex Outhwaite explores the offbeat attractions of Zadar, a Mediterranean port bursting with personality.

programme.title: Timeless Tamil Nadu - Nilgiris, India
programme.desc: From misty tea plantations to forests full of majestic elephants, Alex loses herself in the breathtaking natural beauty of Ooty.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland - Inverness
programme.desc: In the enchanting landscapes of Inverness, Robbie's journey takes a whimsical turn: from eccentric to downright magical.

programme.title: Xplore India - Chhattisgarh 2
programme.desc: As Aradhana’s journey in Chhattisgarh continues, she is stunned to discover the wealth of natural beauty that the state has to offer.

programme.title: The Gypsies - Panchmarhi, India
programme.desc: Without her partner-in-crime joining in her adventures, will Krisann be able to find the best kept secrets of the state's one and only hill station?

programme.title: The Gypsies_Season 2 - Kolhapur,India
programme.desc: Krisann and Reanne’s continue their trip with a stop in the historical city of Kolhapur, nestled in the Sahyadri ranges.

programme.title: Backpack - Plitvice, Lopar and Zagreb, Croatia
programme.desc: Alex Outhwaite explores the island life in Croatia, when she visits the charming Rab Island.

programme.title: Timeless Tamil Nadu - Kodaikanal, India
programme.desc: On a trip to Kodaikanal, Alex is astonished to find an observatory that has been tracking solar activity for around 115 years.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland - Isle Of Skye
programme.desc: The grand finale of Robbie’s wild homecoming unfolds amidst the rugged beauty of the Isle of Skye.

programme.title: 72 Hours Unplugged - Prague
programme.desc: Prague looks like a fairy tale - but Pilar’s not here for the postcards. She’s chasing the city’s secrets.

programme.desc: On the last leg of her journey in Chhattisgarh, Aradhana uncovers the hidden world of the state’s artistic legacy.

programme.title: The Gypsies - Reechgarh, India
programme.desc: Krisann stumbles onto a secret cave that was once inhabited by bears.

programme.title: Timeless Tamil Nadu - Madurai, India
programme.desc: While going to pay her respects at the Meenakshi temple of Madurai, Alex is delighted to find out that there is another side to the revered city.

programme.title: The Gypsies_Season 2 - Aurangabad,India
programme.desc: From a historic fort to a dish with a riveting story behind it, Krisann and Reanne find that Aurangabad is littered with relics of its imperial past.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP7
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP16
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man - EP7
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP13
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP21
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).
